blocks.value: Given String str = "Java";, here are the methods you'll use most often. All of them return a brand new string — none of them change the original, since strings are immutable.

Method                    Example                        Result
charAt(index)             str.charAt(2)                  'v'
compareTo(other)          str.compareTo("Java's")        negative (str is shorter)
concat(other)             str.concat(" program")         "Java program"
equals(other)             str.equals("Java")             true
equalsIgnoreCase(other)   str.equalsIgnoreCase("java")   true
indexOf(sub)              str.indexOf("a")               1 (first match)
lastIndexOf(sub)          str.lastIndexOf("a")           3 (last match)
length()                  str.length()                   4
toLowerCase()              str.toLowerCase()              "java"
toUpperCase()              str.toUpperCase()              "JAVA"
replace(old, new)         str.replace('a', 'o')          "Jovo"
substring(start)          str.substring(2)               "va"
substring(start, end)     str.substring(1, 3)            "av" (end index excluded)
trim()                    " Java Java ".trim()           "Java Java"

String str1 = "Java", str2 = " program";
System.out.println(str1.concat(str2)); // prints "Java program"
